problems_fixed.what: Degenerate problem: sum of first n terms of 4,7,10,... = 115 has no integer n (S_n = n(3n+5)/2 = 115 gives 3n^2+5n-230=0, discriminant 2785, not a perfect square). The stored misconception even carried a wrong factorisation (3n+23)(n-10). Changed the target sum 115 -> 175, which makes S_10 = 175 exactly and 3n^2+5n-350=0 = (n-10)(3n+35), a clean non-calculator quadratic with n=10. Stored solution (10) unchanged; rewrote the misconception and built the full guided walk.
problems_fixed.old: sum is 115 (no integer solution; stored answer 10 was wrong)

opener_concept: A cinema fills row by row: front row 5 seats, each row back adds 2 (5, 7, 9). The fixed +2 is named as the common difference and the rule 2n+3 as the nth term, so a student meets an arithmetic sequence before any algebra. Drawn as an SVG seating plan.
notes: Fresh-solved all 20 bank problems from display text. 19 stored solutions were correct; the only content fix was the degenerate gold[3] sum (115 -> 175). This lesson is ENTIRELY ARITHMETIC (no geometric sequences anywhere), so the method_card and tier_guides were rewritten to arithmetic nth term + membership + sum, dropping the geometric content the AQA sibling carried. Reordered bronze (single_value 10th-term to index 0) and silver (single_value which-term to index 0) so each tier's completion problem deals a valid half-worked walk (originals had a multiple_choice at index 0 with no guided_steps). Rewrote every misconception from solution-dump into honest diagnosis with a derived numeric expect: single_value problems commit the actual error (forgot_constant, used_first_term, substituted_value, used_n_not_n_minus_1, etc.); multiple_choice problems point expect at the distractor index the described error produces (e.g. bronze 5,9,13,17 -> option 1 '4n+5' for using the first term as the constant). Added guided_steps with a phase:'substitute' completion boundary to all 11 single_value problems (set-up pre-worked, solve-through + check live). Added opener, three teach walks (bronze dot-pattern figure, silver membership 4,9,14,19, gold Sn=n^2+4n), tier guides + descriptions. Trimmed method_card to 4 steps / 73 words. Preserved worked_examples, topic_links, related_videos byte-for-byte vs the live pre-state (verified). No em dashes; boxes numeric; tier guides within the 115-word budget.
